<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 650 500" width="650" height="500">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="white"/>

  <!-- Graph Title / Caption -->
  <text x="325" y="475" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 9.1</text>

  <!-- Axes -->
  <line x1="100" y1="400" x2="580" y2="400" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="80" x2="100" y2="430" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Axis Labels -->
  <text x="340" y="445" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle">Time / ms</text>
  <text x="50" y="240" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90, 50, 240)">Membrane potential / mV</text>

  <!-- Y-Axis Ticks & Values -->
  <line x1="95" y1="120" x2="100" y2="120" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="85" y="124" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="end">+40</text>
  
  <line x1="95" y1="180" x2="100" y2="180" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="85" y="184" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="end">0</text>
  
  <line x1="95" y1="280" x2="100" y2="280" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="85" y="284" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="end">-70</text>

  <line x1="95" y1="310" x2="100" y2="310" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="85" y="314" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="end">-80</text>

  <!-- Dashed lines for reference levels -->
  <line x1="100" y1="280" x2="550" y2="280" stroke="#888888" stroke-dasharray="4,4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="560" y="284" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="start">Resting potential</text>

  <!-- Action Potential Curve -->
  <path d="M 120 280 
           Q 220 280 250 270 
           Q 270 260 290 180 
           Q 310 120 330 120 
           Q 350 120 370 180 
           Q 410 310 440 290 
           Q 470 275 540 280" 
        fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Stage Labels A, B, C, D -->
  <!-- A: Resting Potential (flat start) -->
  <text x="170" y="265" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">A</text>

  <!-- B: Depolarisation (rising phase) -->
  <text x="270" y="210" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">B</text>

  <!-- C: Repolarisation (falling phase) -->
  <text x="380" y="235" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">C</text>

  <!-- D: Hyperpolarisation (dip below resting) -->
  <text x="440" y="340" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">D</text>

</svg>
